title: Chocolates and Cheers Chocolate Making and Optional Wine Tasting
blurb:
Indulge in a delightful chocolate-making with an optional wine or craft beer tasting at The Wine Experience on Cannery Row, Monterey. Under the guidance of Carrie Griffin, a seasoned wine curator turned chocolate enthusiast, learn to temper chocolate, craft truffle shells, and fill them with smooth ganache. This two-hour hands-on class ensures you leave with a beautiful box of your own decadent creations, perfect for sharing or indulging yourself. Whether it’s a romantic date night or a fun outing with friends, this experience is sure to satisfy your sweet tooth.

Two-hour chocolate truffle-making class at Cannery Row
Optional tastings of four Central Coast wines or craft beers
Led by Carrie Griffin, a passionate host with years of wine expertise
Group sizes up to 10, perfect for couples, friends, and private parties
